column3: The Hebrew says “his foreskin,” without separately repeating “the boy.”
The Hebrew says she remains “in the blood of purification,” rather than “in purification from her bleeding.”
The Hebrew says she remains by the blood of purification, rather than in purification from her bleeding.
The object presented is singular “it,” rather than “them”; the Hebrew retains the image of “the fountain of her blood.”
The Hebrew retains the image of her hand not finding enough for a sheep and says she takes the two birds.
